title: Patch Tuesday November 2026: 1,093 CVEs, including CVE-2026-124194 (exploited Outlook flaw)
content_md:
Patch Tuesday November 2026: 1,093 CVEs, including CVE-2026-124194 (exploited Outlook flaw). On November 10, 2026, Microsoft patched 1,093 vulnerabilities.

via Mastodon https://blog.marcfredericgomez.fr/patch-tuesday-novembre-2026-1093-cve/

CVE-2026-124194.evidence: Post describes the Outlook flaw as exploited; consistent with the existing Patch Tuesday story.
